patch.value: Route jira export dry-run preview to stderr + return payloads so stdout stays valid JSON

pm jira export corrupted stdout: extension console.log'd the payloads to stdout while the SDK host also renders the return object, yielding JSON+trailing-YAML. Fix: route preview to stderr and include payloads in the returned object so --json is clean+complete. Mirror of companion item pm-cli-website-ex9n.
